vanilla_completion.note: 2026-09-21: where vanilla gives an ownable location a river and the network drawing does not (2,122 locations: mainstems rasterised on one bank only, e.g. Cairo; small rivers below the discharge cut; delta distributaries the downstream tree cannot carry), a one-pixel bank detour of the mainstem or a copy of vanilla's own river piece (with one pixel of clearance, as its own tree) gives the location its river. Levels: the mainstem's for detours, vanilla's widths for pieces.

export.waterways_note: 2026-09-21: named waterways drawn as their own trees (river_waterways.py) where real water is missing from both the RiverATLAS tree and vanilla's bitmap: the Grand Canal south of the Yangtze (Hangzhou-Chongde-Jiaxing-Wujiang-Suzhou(wuxian)-Wuxi-Changzhou(wujin)-Danyang-Zhenjiang(dantu)), the Shangtang canal along Hangzhou Bay, the Yuanhe canal Suzhou-Changshu, the Zhedong canal Xiaoshan-Ningbo(yinxian), and two rivers below the discharge cut (Xitiaoxi Anji-Huzhou(wuxing), Dongyang River Dongyang-Yiwu-Jinhua). The path stays inside the listed locations, keeps clearance from every other river and stops one pixel inside the last location; a location keeps a higher level it already has. Levels: 3 for the Grand Canal trunk, 2 for the rest.
